				.set("prompt2", `你可以跳过一个阶段，令${get.translation(trigger.card)}对你无效${targets.length ? `，然后你与${get.translation(targets)}互相观看对方手牌并可获得其中至多三张牌` : ""}`)
				.set("ai", () => {
					const { player, controls } = get.event();
					const trigger = get.event().getTrigger();
					if (get.effect(player, trigger.card, trigger.player, player) >= 0) {
						return "cancel2";
					}
					return ["phaseDiscard", "phaseJudge", "phaseUse", "phaseDraw"].find(phase => controls.includes(phase)) || controls.randomGet();
				})
				.forResult();
			event.result = {
				bool: result.control !== "cancel2",
				cost_data: result.control,
			};
		},
		usable: 1,
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const phase = event.cost_data;
			player.skip(phase);
			game.log(player, "跳过了", `#y${get.translation(phase)}`);
			trigger.getParent().excluded.add(player);
			game.log(trigger.card, "对", player, "无效");
			const targets = player.getStorage("dcmingjie_effect");
			for (const target of targets.sortBySeat()) {
				if (!target.isIn()) {
					continue;
				}
				const list = [player, target];
				const map = await game.chooseAnyOL(list, get.info(event.name).choosePlayerCard, [list]).forResult();
				const cards1 = [];
				const cards2 = [];
				for (const current of list) {
					const result = map.get(current);
					if (result?.links?.length) {
						if (player === current) {
							cards2.addArray(result.links);
						} else {
							cards1.addArray(result.links);
						}
					}
				}
				if (cards1.length || cards2.length) {
					await player.swapHandcards(target, cards1, cards2);
				}
			}
		},
		choosePlayerCard(player, targets, eventId) {
			const target = targets[0] === player ? targets[1] : targets[0];
			const str = get.translation(target);
			return player
				.choosePlayerCard({
					prompt: `娴辅：你可以获得${str}的至多三张手牌`,
					target,
					position: "h",
					visible: true,
					allowChooseAll: true,
					selectButton: [1, 3],
					chooseonly: true,
				})
				.set("ai", button => {
					const { player, target } = get.event();
					const att = get.attitude(player, target);
					if (att > 0) {
						if (player === _status.currentPhase) {
							return player.getUseValue(button.link);
						}
						if (target === _status.currentPhase) {
							return -get.value(button.link);
						}
						return 6 - get.value(button.link);
					}
					return 1;
				})
				.set("id", eventId)
				.set("_global_waiting", true);
		},
		ai: {
			threaten: 0.8,
			expose: 0.2,
			effect: {
				target(card, player, target) {
					if (_status._dcxianfu_check || target.getStat().triggerSkill?.dcxianfu) {
						return;
					}
					const targets = target.getStorage("dcmingjie_effect");
					if (!targets.some(current => current.isIn()) || !Array.isArray(lib.phaseName)) {
						return;
					}
					if (!lib.phaseName.some(item => !["phaseZhunbei", "phaseJieshu"].includes(item) && !target.skipList.includes(item))) {
						return;
					}
					_status._dcxianfu_check = true;
					const eff = get.effect(target, card, player, target);
					delete _status._dcxianfu_check;
					if (eff < 0) {
						return 0.5;
					}
				},
			},
		},
	},

	dczisheng: {
		getNumber(card) {
			if (get.is.convertedCard(card)) {
				return card.cards.reduce((num, card) => num + get.number(card, false), 0);
			}
			if (typeof get.number(card, false) === "number") {
				return get.number(card, false);
			}
			return null;
		},
		getNum(event, player, target) {
			if (event.type === "gain" || event.name === "gain") {
				const cards1 = event.getl?.(target)?.cards2 || [];
				const cards2 = event.getg?.(player) || [];
				const num1 = target.getHp();
				const num2 = cards2.filter(card => cards1.includes(card)).length;
				return Math.min(num1, num2);
			} else {
				const num1 = target.getHp();
				const num2 = event.getl?.(target)?.cards2?.length || 0;
				return Math.min(num1, num2);
			}
		},
		audio: 2,
		trigger: { player: "useCard" },
		filter(event, player) {
			const number = get.info("dczisheng").getNumber(event.card);
			return typeof number === "number" && number > 3 && number % 3 === 0;
		},
		prompt2: "从牌堆中随机三张点数为3的牌中选择一张获得",
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const cards = Array.from(ui.cardPile.childNodes)
				.filter(card => get.number(card) === 3)
				.randomGets(3);
			if (cards.length) {
				const result = await player
					.chooseButton({
						createDialog: ["恣胜：获得其中一张牌", cards],
						forced: true,
						ai(button) {
							return player.getUseValue(button.link);
						},
					})
					.forResult();
				if (result?.bool && result.links?.length) {
					await player.gain({ cards: result.links, animate: "draw" });
				}
			} else {
				player.popup("杯具");
			}
		},
		group: "dczisheng_dam",
		subSkill: {
			dam: {
				audio: "dczisheng",
				trigger: {
					player: "gainAfter",
					global: ["loseAfter", "loseAsyncAfter"],
				},
				getIndex(event, player) {
					if (event.type === "gain" || event.name === "gain") {
						return game
							.filterPlayer(current => {
								if (player === current) {
									return false;
								}
								const cards1 = event.getl?.(current)?.cards2;
								const cards2 = event.getg?.(player);
								return cards2?.containsSome(...cards1);
							})
							.sortBySeat();
					} else {
						if (event.type !== "discard") {
							return 0;
						}
						if ((event.discarder || event.getParent(2)?.player) !== player) {
							return false;
						}
						return game
							.filterPlayer(current => {
								if (player === current) {
									return false;
								}
								const cards = event.getl?.(current)?.cards2;
								return cards.length > 0;
							})
							.sortBySeat();
					}
				},
				filter(event, player, name, target) {
					return target?.getHp() > 0 && target.isIn();
				},
				logTarget(event, player, name, target) {
					return target;
				},
				prompt2(event, player, name, target) {
					const num = get.info("dczisheng").getNum(event, player, target);
					return `对其造成${num}点伤害`;
				},
				check(event, player, name, target) {
					return get.damageEffect(target, player, player) > 0;
				},
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					const target = event.targets[0];
					const num = get.info("dczisheng").getNum(trigger, player, target);
					await target.damage({ num });
				},
			},
		},
	},
	dcxianlve: {
		onChooseToUse(event) {
			if (!game.online) {
				const { player } = event;
				const targets = game.filterPlayer(current => {
					if (player === current || player.getStorage("dcxianlve_used").includes(current) || !current.hasCards("h")) {
						return false;
					}
					return current.hasHistory("damage", evt => evt.num > 0) || current.hasHistory("lose", evt => evt.cards2?.length);
				});
				event.set("dcxianlve", targets);
			}
		},
		audio: 2,
		enable: "phaseUse",
		filter(event, player) {
			return event.dcxianlve?.length;
		},
		filterTarget(card, player, target) {
			return get.event().dcxianlve?.includes(target);
		},
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const { target } = event;
			player.addTempSkill(`${event.name}_used`);
			player.markAuto(`${event.name}_used`, [target]);
			const limit = `${event.name}_369`;
			player.storage[limit] ??= [3, 6, 9];
			const cards = target.getCards("h");
			await player.viewCards(`${get.translation(target)}的手牌`, cards);
			const numbers = cards.map(card => get.number(card, false));
			player.markAuto(event.name, numbers);
			player.storage[event.name].sort((a, b) => a - b);
			player.markSkill(event.name);
			while (true) {
				if (player.getStorage(limit).length && player.getStorage(event.name).length > player.getStorage(limit)[0]) {
					await player.draw(3);
					player.storage[limit].shift();
				} else {
					break;
				}
			}
			if (player.getStorage(event.name).length >= 13 - player.countMark(`${event.name}_dying`)) {
				player.setStorage(event.name, [], true);
				player.setStorage(limit, [3, 6, 9], true);
				player.clearMark(`${event.name}_dying`, false);
				if (player.hasSkill("dchaoxian", null, false, false) && player.awakenedSkills.includes("dchaoxian")) {
					player.restoreSkill("dchaoxian");
					game.log(player, "重置了", "#g【豪贤】");
				}
			}
		},
		mark: true,
		onremove: ["dcxianlve", "dcxianlve_dying", "dcxianlve_369"],
		intro: {
			content(storage = [], player) {
				if (!storage.length) {
					return "暂无记录";
				}
				return `已记录点数：${storage.join("、")}`;
			},
			markcount(storage = [], player, skill) {
				return `${storage.length}/${13 - player.countMark(`${skill}_dying`)}`;
			},
		},
		ai: {
			order: 10,
			result: {
				player(player, target) {
					return target.countCards("h");
				},
			},
		},
		derivation: "dchaoxian",
		group: ["dcxianlve_dying"],
		subSkill: {
			used: { charlotte: true, onremove: true },
			dying: {
				audio: "dcxianlve",
				trigger: { source: "dying" },
				filter(event, player) {
					if (event.player === player) {
						return false;
					}
					return event.reason?.name === "damage";
				},
				forced: true,
				locked: false,
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					player.addMark(event.name, 3, false);
				},
				onremove: true,
			},
		},
	},
	dchaoxian: {
		audio: 2,
		limited: true,
		skillAnimation: true,
		animationColor: "fire",
		enable: "phaseUse",
		manualConfirm: true,
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			player.awakenSkill(event.name);
			const cards = Array.from(ui.discardPile.childNodes).filter(card => get.number(card) === 3);
			if (cards.length) {
				const next = game.cardsGotoPile(cards);
				next.set("insert_index", () => {
					return ui.cardPile.childNodes[get.rand(0, ui.cardPile.childNodes.length - 1)];
				});
				await next;
				game.log(player, `将${get.cnNumber(cards.length)}张牌洗入了牌堆`);
			}
			for (const target of game.filterPlayer(current => current !== player).sortBySeat()) {
				if (!target.isIn()) {
					continue;
				}
				const cards = target.getGainableCards(player, "h", card => get.number(card) === 3);

							return 1;
						}
						return 0;
					},
				})

			let controlList = ["弃置牌", "失去体力", "cancel2"];
			for (const i of [0, 1]) {
				const list = ["discard", "loseHp"];
				const bool1 = player.getStorage("dcsbyouyi_used")?.includes(list[i]);
				const bool2 = i === 0 ? Boolean(!player.hasDiscardableCards("he")) : false;
				if (bool1 || bool2) {
					if (bool1) {
						choiceList[i] += "（已发动）";
					} else {
						choiceList[i] += "（无法执行）";
					}
					choiceList[i] = `<span style="opacity:0.5">'${choiceList[i]}</span>`;
					controlList[i] = "";
				}
			}
			controlList = controlList.filter(i => i !== "");
			const result = await player
				.chooseControl({
					prompt: get.prompt(event.skill),
					controls: controlList,
					choiceList,

								return val >= 3;

						if (list.includes("失去体力") && player.hp >= 4) {

						return evt !== eventx && evt.card?.name === "sha" && evt.targets.length === 1 && evt.target !== player;
					} else {
						return evt !== eventx && get.type(evt.card) === "trick" && evt.targets.length === 1 && evt.target !== player;
					}
				},
				eventx
			);
			return !history.length;
		},
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const target = trigger.target;
			const card = trigger.card;
			if (!target || !card) {
				return;
			}
			const result = await player
				.chooseControl("响应", "不响应")
				.set("prompt", `猜测你的${get.translation(card)}是否被响应`)
				.set("ai", () => {
					return [0, 1].randomGet();
				})
				.forResult();
			player.addTempSkill("dcsbxinzhan_eff");
			player.markAuto("dcsbxinzhan_eff", [
				{
					target: target,
					card: card,
					result: result.control,
				},
			]);
		},
		check(event, player) {
			if (!event.target) {
				return false;
			}
			return get.attitude(player, event.target) < 0;
		},
		subSkill: {
			eff: {
				forced: true,
				charlotte: true,
				trigger: { player: "useCardAfter" },
				filter(event, player) {
					const storage = player.getStorage("dcsbxinzhan_eff");
					if (!storage) {
						return false;
					}
					return storage.some(item => {
						return item.card === event.card;
					});
				},
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					const item = player.storage["dcsbxinzhan_eff"].find(i => i.card === trigger.card);
					player.storage["dcsbxinzhan_eff"].remove(item);
					const { target, card, result } = item;
					let xiangying = "不响应";
					game.checkGlobalHistory("everything", evt => {
						if (["useCard", "respond"].includes(evt.name)) {
							if (Array.isArray(evt.respondTo) && evt.respondTo[1] === card) {
								xiangying = "响应";
							}
						}
					});
					if (xiangying === result) {
						if (target.isIn() && target.countCards("he")) {
							await player.gainPlayerCard(target, 1, "he", true, "visible");
						}
						player.recover();
					} else {
						const card0 = get.cardPile(card => card.name === "sha");
						if (card0) {
							await player.gain(card0, "gain2");
						}
						const cardx = new lib.element.VCard({ name: "juedou", isCard: true });
						if (target.isIn() && player.canUse(cardx, target)) {
							await player.useCard(cardx, target);
						}
					}
				},
				sub: true,
				sourceSkill: "dcsbxinzhan",
			},
		},
	},
	dcsbchengce: {
		audio: 2,
		trigger: { global: "roundStart" },
		filter(event, player) {
			return game.countPlayer() > 1;
		},
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const cards = get.cards(2, true);
			if (!cards.length) {
				return;
			}
			await game.cardsGotoOrdering(cards);
			const list = [["牌堆顶的牌", cards]];
			let prompt = "观看牌堆顶的两张牌";
			const hs = player.getCards("h");
			if (hs.length) {
				list.push(["你的手牌", hs]);
				prompt = "用任意张手牌交换牌堆顶的等量牌";
			}
			const result = await player
				.chooseToMove({
					prompt: prompt,
					forced: true,
					filterMove: (from, to) => {
						return typeof to !== "number";
					},
					list: list,
					num: 2,
				})
				.forResult();
			event.forceDie = true;
			if (result?.moved?.[1]?.length) {
				const lose = result.moved[0].slice();
				const gain = result.moved[1].slice().filter(i => !get.owner(i));
				if (lose.some(i => get.owner(i))) {
					await player.lose(
						lose.filter(i => get.owner(i)),
						ui.special
					);
				}
				await game.cardsGotoPile(lose.slice().reverse(), "insert");
				game.updateRoundNumber();
				if (gain.length) {
					await player.gain(gain, "draw");
				}
			} else {
				if (result?.moved?.[0]?.length) {
					await game.cardsGotoPile(result.moved[0].slice().reverse(), "insert");
				}
			}
			if (game.countPlayer() < 2) {
				return;
			}
			if (player.isIn()) {
				const result1 = await player
					.chooseTarget({
						prompt: "令一名其他角色观看牌堆顶两张牌并获得其中一张",
						forced: true,
						filterTarget: (card, player, target) => {
							return target !== player;
						},
						ai: target => {
							const player = get.player();
							return get.attitude(player, target);
						},
					})
					.forResult();
				const target = result1.targets[0];
				const cards0 = get.cards(2, true);
				const result2 = await target
					.chooseButton({
						createDialog: ["选择一张牌获得", cards0],
						forced: true,
						ai: button => {
							const card = button.link;
							let val = get.value(card);
							if (!get.tag(card, "damage")) {
								val += 5;
							}
							return val;
						},
					})
					.forResult();
				const card0 = result2.links[0];
				if (!card0) {
					return;
				}
				await target.gain(card0, "draw");
				if (get.tag(card0, "damage")) {
					if (player.isIn()) {
						const cardsx = [];
						while (cardsx.length < 2) {
							const card = get.cardPile(i => get.tag(i, "damage") && !cardsx.includes(i));
							if (card) {
								cardsx.push(card);
							} else {
								break;
							}
						}
						await player.gain(cardsx, "draw");
					}
					if (target.isIn()) {
						const cardsx = target.getCards("h").randomGets(2);
						if (cardsx?.length) {
							target.addTempSkill(`${event.name}_sha`, { global: "roundEnd" });
							target.addGaintag(cardsx, `${event.name}_sha`);
						}
					}
				} else {
					if (player.isIn()) {
						const cardsx = [];
						while (cardsx.length < 2) {
							const card = get.cardPile(i => !get.tag(i, "damage") && !cardsx.includes(i));
							if (card) {
								cardsx.push(card);
							} else {
								break;
							}
						}
						await player.gain(cardsx, "draw");
						player.addSkill(`${event.name}_mianshang`);
					}
					if (target.isIn()) {
						target.addTempSkill("dcsbxinzhan", { global: "roundEnd" });
					}
				}
			}
		},
		check: (event, player) => {
			return game.hasPlayer(current => {
				return current !== player && get.attitude(player, current) > 0;
			});
		},
		subSkill: {
			sha: {
				charlotte: true,
				mod: {
					cardname(card) {
						if (get.itemtype(card) === "card" && card.hasGaintag("dcsbchengce_sha")) {
							return "sha";
						}
					},
					cardnature(card) {
						if (get.itemtype(card) === "card" && card.hasGaintag("dcsbchengce_sha")) {
							return false;
						}
					},
				},
				trigger: {
					global: "roundEnd",
				},
				onremove(player, skill) {
					player.removeGaintag("dcsbchengce_sha");
				},
				sub: true,
				sourceSkill: "dcsbchengce",
			},
			mianshang: {
				charlotte: true,
				forced: true,
				trigger: { player: "damageBegin4" },
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					player.removeSkill(event.name);
					trigger.cancel();
				},
				mark: true,
				intro: {
					content: "防止下次受到的伤害",
				},
				sub: true,
				sourceSkill: "dcsbchengce",
			},
		},
	},
	//谋诸葛亮
	dcsbjingmou: {
		audio: 2,
		audioname: ["dc_sb_zhugeliang_shadow"],
		derivation: "dcsbdingnan",
		zhuanhuanji(player, skill) {
			player.storage[skill] = !player.storage[skill];
			player.changeSkin({ characterName: "dc_sb_zhugeliang" }, `dc_sb_zhugeliang${player.storage[skill] ? "_shadow" : ""}`);
		},
		marktext: "☯",
		mark: true,
		intro: {
			content(storage, player) {
				return `任意角色出牌阶段开始时，若你未有记录的花色或牌类型，你可弃置任意张牌并秘密记录其中包含的至多三种花色与牌类型。有角色使用与你记录的花色或类型相同的牌时，移除该记录。${storage ? "此牌结算后将其交给任意一名角色" : "你可令此牌无效并弃置牌堆顶一张牌，若与此牌花色一致对其造成1点火焰伤害"}。`;
			},
		},
		trigger: { global: "phaseUseBegin" },
		filter(event, player) {
			return player.hasDiscardableCards(player, "he") && !player.getStorage("dcsbjingmou_mark").length;
		},
		async cost(event, trigger, player) {
			event.result = await player
				.chooseToDiscard({
					prompt: get.prompt(event.skill),
					prompt2: "弃置任意张牌并记录其中包含的至多三种花色与类型",
					selectCard: [1, Infinity],
					complexCard: true,
					position: "he",
					chooseonly: true,
					ai(card) {
						if (card.hasGaintag("dcsbguyi_tag")) {
							return 10 - get.value(card);
						}
						if (ui.selected.cards?.length < 3) {
							return 7 - get.value(card);
						}
						return 0;
					},
				})
				.forResult();
		},
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const { cards } = event;
			const types = cards.map(card => get.type2(card)).unique();
			const suits = cards.map(card => get.suit(card)).unique();
			await player.discard({ cards, discarder: player });
			const typeMap = {};
			types.forEach(type => {
				typeMap[get.translation(type)] = type;
			});
			const suitMap = {};
			suits.forEach(suit => {
				suitMap[get.translation(suit)] = suit;
			});
			const result = await player
				.chooseButton({
					createDialog: [
						"靖谋：记录至多三种花色与类型",
						[
							[types.slice(0).map(type => get.translation(type)), "tdnodes"],
							[suits.slice(0).map(suit => get.translation(suit)), "tdnodes"],
						],
					],
					selectButton: [1, 6],
					complexButton: true,
					filterButton(button) {
						let { types, suits } = get.event();
						types = types.slice(0).map(type => get.translation(type));
						suits = suits.slice(0).map(suit => get.translation(suit));
						if (!ui.selected.buttons?.length) {
							return true;
						}
						const selectedTypes = ui.selected.buttons.filter(b => types.includes(b.link)).length;
						const selectedSuits = ui.selected.buttons.filter(b => suits.includes(b.link)).length;
						if (types.includes(button.link)) {
							return selectedTypes < Math.min(3, types.length);
						} else if (suits.includes(button.link)) {
							return selectedSuits < Math.min(3, suits.length);
						}
						return true;
					},
					ai(button) {
						return 1 + Math.random();
					},
				})
				.set("types", types)
				.set("suits", suits)
				.forResult();
			if (result?.bool && result.links?.length) {
				const { links } = result;
				const list = [];
				for (const link of links) {
					if (typeMap[link]) {
						list.push(typeMap[link]);
					}
					if (suitMap[link]) {
						list.push(suitMap[link]);
					}
				}
				player.markAuto(`${event.name}_mark`, list);
			}
		},
		group: ["dcsbjingmou_change", "dcsbjingmou_mark"],
		subSkill: {
			mark2: { charlotte: true, onremove: true },
			mark: {
				audio: "dcsbjingmou",
				forced: true,
				onremove: true,
				audioname: ["dc_sb_zhugeliang_shadow"],
				intro: {
					content(storage, player) {
						if (player.isUnderControl(true)) {
							return `已记录：${get.translation(storage)}`;
						} else {
							return `已记录${storage?.length || 0}个花色或类型数`;
						}
					},
				},
				trigger: { global: "useCard" },
				logTarget: "player",
				filter(event, player) {
					return [get.type2(event.card), get.suit(event.card)].some(link => player.getStorage("dcsbjingmou_mark").includes(link));
				},
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					const links = [get.type2(trigger.card), get.suit(trigger.card)].filter(link => player.getStorage(event.name).includes(link));
					player.unmarkAuto(event.name, links);
					player.addSkill("dcsbjingmou_mark2");
					player.markAuto("dcsbjingmou_mark2", links);
					if (player.getStorage("dcsbjingmou_mark2").length >= 7) {
						await player.addSkills("dcsbdingnan");
					}
					const {
						targets: [target],
					} = event;
					if (!player.storage.dcsbjingmou) {
						const result = await player
							.chooseBool({
								prompt: get.prompt(event.name, target),
								prompt2: `令${get.translation(trigger.card)}无效并弃置牌堆顶的一张牌。若与此牌花色相同则对其造成1点火焰伤害`,
								ai() {
									const { player, target, card, targets } = get.event();
									let effect = 0;
									if (card.name === "wuxie" || card.name === "shan") {
										if (get.attitude(player, target) < -1) {
											effect = -1;
										}
									} else if (targets?.length) {
										for (let i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
											effect += get.effect(targets[i], card, target, player);
										}
									}
									if (effect < 0) {
										if (card.name === "sha") {
											const targetx = targets[0];
											if (targetx === player) {
												return !player.countCards("h", "shan");
											} else {
												return targetx.hp === 1 || (targetx.countCards("h") <= 2 && targetx.hp <= 2);
											}
										} else {
											return true;
										}
									}
									return false;
								},
							})
							.set("target", target)
							.set("targets", trigger.targets)
							.set("card", trigger.card)
							.forResult();
						if (result?.bool) {
							trigger.targets.length = 0;
							trigger.all_excluded = true;
							const cards = get.cards(1);
							await game.cardsDiscard(cards);
							game.log(player, "弃置了", cards, "#g（源自牌堆）");
							if (get.suit(trigger.card) === get.suit(cards[0])) {
								await trigger.player.damage("fire");
							}
						}
					} else {
						player
							.when({ global: "useCardAfter" })
							.filter(evt => evt === trigger && evt.cards?.filterInD("od")?.length)
							.step(async (event, trigger, player) => {
								const cards = trigger.cards.filterInD("od");
								const result = await player
									.chooseTarget({
										prompt: `靖谋：将${get.translation(cards)}交给一名角色`,
										ai(target) {
											return get.attitude(get.player(), target);
										},
									})
									.forResult();
								if (result?.bool && result.targets?.length) {
									const target = result.targets[0];
									player.line(target);
									await target.gain({ cards, animate: "gain2", giver: player });
								}
							});
					}
					player.changeZhuanhuanji("dcsbjingmou");
				},
			},
			change: {
				audio: "dcsbjingmou",
				audioname: ["dc_sb_zhugeliang_shadow"],
				trigger: {
					global: "phaseBefore",
					player: "enterGame",
				},
				filter(event, player) {
					return event.name !== "phase" || game.phaseNumber === 0;
				},
				prompt2(event, player) {
					return `切换【靖谋】为状态${player.storage.dcsbjingmou ? "阳" : "阴"}`;
				},
				check: () => Math.random() > 0.5,
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					player.changeZhuanhuanji("dcsbjingmou");
				},
			},
		},
	},
	dcsbdingnan: {
		audio: 2,
		audioname: ["dc_sb_zhugeliang_shadow"],
		enable: "phaseUse",
		usable: 1,
		filterTarget: true,
		selectTarget: [1, Infinity],
		multitarget: true,
		multiline: true,
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const { targets } = event;
			for (const target of targets.sortBySeat()) {
				const result = await target
					.chooseToRespond({
						filterCard(card, player, event) {
							if (get.name(card) !== "sha") {
								return false;
							}
							return lib.filter.cardRespondable(card, player, event);
						},
						prompt: `定南：打出一张【杀】，否则受到${get.translation(player)}的1点伤害`,
						ai(card) {
							return 1 + Math.random();
						},
					})
					.forResult();
				if (!result?.bool) {
					await target.damage();
				}
			}
		},
		ai: {
			order: 5,
			result: {
				player: 1,
				target: -1,
			},
		},
	},
	dcsbguyi: {
		audio: 2,
		audioname: ["dc_sb_zhugeliang_shadow"],
		forced: true,
		trigger: {
			player: "loseAfter",
			global: ["phaseBegin", "equipAfter", "addJudgeAfter", "gainAfter", "loseAsyncAfter", "addToExpansionAfter"],
		},
		onremove(player, skill) {
			player.removeGaintag(`${skill}_tag`);
		},
		filter(event, player) {
			if (event.name === "phase") {
				return !player.hasCards("h", card => card.hasGaintag("dcsbguyi_tag"));
			}
			if (player.countMark("dcsbguyi_used") > 2) {
				return false;
			}
			const evt = event.getl?.(player);
			return evt?.cards2?.length;
		},
		getIndex(event, player) {
			if (event.name === "phase") {
				return 1;
			}
			let num = 0;
			const evt = event.getl?.(player);
			for (const i in evt.gaintag_map) {
				if (evt.gaintag_map[i].includes("dcsbguyi_tag")) {
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		},
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			if (trigger.name === "phase") {
				await player.draw(1);
				if (!player.hasCards("h")) {
					return;
				}
				const result = await player
					.chooseCard({
						prompt: "孤熠：选择一张手牌标记为“熠”",
						forced: true,
						position: "h",
						ai(card) {
							return get.player().getUseValue(card);
						},
					})
					.forResult();
				if (result?.bool && result.cards?.length) {
					player.addGaintag(result.cards, `${event.name}_tag`);
				}
			} else {
				const num = Math.min(7, player.countMark("dcsbguyi_round") + 1);
				const cards = get.cards(num, true);
				await game.cardsGotoOrdering(cards);
				const result = await player
					.chooseToMove_new({
						prompt: "孤熠：获得一张牌标记为“熠”并将其余牌以任意顺序放回牌堆顶（靠左的在上）",
						forced: true,
						list: [["牌堆顶", cards], ["获得"]],
						filterMove(from, to, moved) {
							if (to === 1 && moved[1].length >= 1) {
								return false;
							}
							return true;
						},
						filterOk(moved) {
							return moved[1].length === 1;
						},
						processAI(list) {
							const cards = list[0][1].slice(0).sort((a, b) => {
								return get.value(b) - get.value(a);
							});
							return [cards.splice(1), cards];
						},
					})
					.forResult();
				if (result?.bool && result.moved?.length) {
					player.addTempSkill(`${event.name}_used`);
					player.addMark(`${event.name}_used`, 1, false);
					player.addTempSkill(`${event.name}_round`, "roundStart");
					player.addMark(`${event.name}_round`, 1, false);
					const { moved } = result;
					const top = moved[0];
					const gains = moved[1];
					if (gains.length) {
						await player.gain({
							cards: gains,
							animate: "gain2",
							gaintag: ["dcsbguyi_tag"],
						});
					}
					await game.cardsGotoPile(top.reverse(), "insert");
				}
			}
		},
		mod: {
			aiOrder(player, card, num) {
				if (get.itemtype(card) === "card" && card.hasGaintag("dcsbguyi_tag")) {
					return num + 0.1;
				}
			},
			aiValue(player, card, num) {
				if (get.itemtype(card) === "card" && card.hasGaintag("dcsbguyi_tag")) {
					return num / 10;
				}
			},
			aiUseful() {
				return lib.skill.dcsbguyi.mod.aiValue.apply(this, arguments);
			},
		},
		subSkill: {
			tag: {},
			used: { charlotte: true, onremove: true },
			round: { charlotte: true, onremove: true },
		},
	},
	//神关羽
	dcwushen: {

					return "sha";

	dckeming: {
		audio: 2,
		trigger: {
			player: "damageEnd",
			source: "damageSource",
		},
		filter(event, player, name) {
			return name === "damageEnd" ? event.source?.isIn() && event.source !== player : event.player?.isIn() && event.player !== player;
		},
		async cost(event, trigger, player) {
			if (event.triggername === "damageSource") {
				event.result = { bool: true };
			} else {
				event.result = await player
					.chooseBool({
						prompt: get.prompt(event.skill, trigger.source),
						prompt2: `发动${get.translation(trigger.source)}的“受到伤害后”技能，若没有则随机发动一个“曹”姓武将此时机的技能。`,
						choice: true,
					})
					.forResult();
			}
		},
		logTarget(event, player, name) {
			return name === "damageEnd" ? event.source : event.player;
		},
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const {
				targets: [target],
			} = event;
			if (event.triggername === "damageSource") {
				player.addTempSkill(`${event.name}_effect`, { player: "dieAfter" });
				player.markAuto(`${event.name}_effect`, target);
			} else {
				const checkTrigger = skill => {
					if (player.hasSkill(skill, null, false, false)) {
						return false;
					}
					const info = get.info(skill);
					if (!info || info.charlotte) {
						return false;
					}
					const list = [skill];
					game.expandSkills(list);
					const name = "damageEnd";
					for (const i of list) {
						const info = get.info(i);
						if (!info || !info.trigger || info.silent) {
							return false;
						}
						const toArray = arr => {
							return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : !arr ? [] : [arr];
						};
						const triggers = [...toArray(info.trigger?.player), ...toArray(info.trigger?.global)];
						if (triggers.includes(name)) {
							if (info.ai && (info.ai.combo || info.ai.notemp || info.ai.neg)) {
								return false;
							}
							if (info.init) {
								return false;
							}
							if (typeof info.getIndex === "function") {
								try {
									const indexedResult = info.getIndex(trigger, player, name);
									if (Array.isArray(indexedResult)) {
										if (!info.filter || indexedResult.some(indexedData => info.filter(trigger, player, name, indexedData))) {
											return true;
										}
									}
									if (typeof indexedResult === "number" && indexedResult > 0) {
										if (!info.filter || info.filter(trigger, player, name)) {
											return true;
										}
									}
									return false;
								} catch (e) {
									return false;
								}
							} else if (info.filter) {
								try {
									const bool = info.filter(trigger, player, name);
									if (!bool) {
										return false;
									}
								} catch (e) {
									return false;
								}
							}
							return true;
						}
					}
				};
				let skills = target.getStockSkills(true, true).filter(skill => checkTrigger(skill));
				if (!skills.length) {
					if (!_status.characterlist) {
						game.initCharacterList();
					}
					const list = _status.characterlist.filter(name => get.characterSurname(name).some(j => j[0] === "曹") && get.character(name).skills.some(skill => checkTrigger(skill)));
					if (!list.length) {
						player.chat("无将可用");
						return;
					}
					skills = get
						.character(list.randomGet())
						.skills.filter(i => checkTrigger(i))
						.randomGets(1);
				}
				player.addInvisibleSkill(skills);
				player.addTempSkill(`${event.name}_check`);
				player.markAuto(`${event.name}_check`, skills);
				const next = game.createEvent(`${event.name}_check`, false, trigger);
				next.player = player;
				next.skills = skills;
				trigger.next.remove(next);
				trigger.after.push(next);
				next.setContent(async (event, trigger, player) => {
					const { skills } = event;
					player.removeInvisibleSkill(skills);
					player.removeSkill("dckeming_check");
				});
			}
		},
		subSkill: {
			check: {
				charlotte: true,
				onremove: true,
				silent: true,
				trigger: { player: ["logSkillBegin", "useSkill"] },
				filter(event, player) {
					const info = get.info(event.skill);
					if (info && info.charlotte) {
						return false;
					}
					const skill = get.sourceSkillFor(event);
					return player.getStorage("dckeming_check").includes(skill);
				},
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					const skill = get.sourceSkillFor(trigger);
					player.removeInvisibleSkill(skill);
					player.unmarkAuto(event.name, skill);
					if (!player.getStorage(event.name).length) {
						player.removeSkill(event.name);
					}
				},
				group: "dckeming_trigger",
			},
			trigger: {
				charlotte: true,
				trigger: { player: "triggerInvisible" },
				filter(event, player) {
					if (event.revealed) {
						return false;
					}
					const info = get.info(event.skill);
					if (!info || info.charlotte) {
						return false;
					}
					const skills = player.getStorage("dckeming_check").slice();
					game.expandSkills(skills);
					return skills.includes(event.skill);
				},
				forced: true,
				popup: false,
				priority: 10,
				forceDie: true,
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					let result;
					if (get.info(trigger.skill).silent) {
						return;
					} else {
						const info = get.info(trigger.skill);
						// 这里的trigger（event._trigger）即是content.createTrigger的event
						const evt = trigger;
						const evtTrigger = evt._trigger;
						let str;
						const check = info.check;
						// 照抄content.createTrigger的技能提示部分
						if (info.prompt) {
							str = info.prompt;
						} else {
							if (typeof info.logTarget === "string") {
								str = get.prompt(evt.skill, evtTrigger[info.logTarget], player);
							} else if (typeof info.logTarget === "function") {
								const logTarget = info.logTarget(evtTrigger, player, evt.triggername, evt.indexedData);
								if (get.itemtype(logTarget)?.indexOf("player") === 0) {
									str = get.prompt(evt.skill, logTarget, player);
								}
							} else {
								str = get.prompt(evt.skill, null, player);
							}
						}
						if (typeof str === "function") {
							str = str(evtTrigger, player, evt.triggername, evt.indexedData);
						}
						const next = player.chooseBool(`刻名：${str}`);
						next.set("yes", !info.check || info.check(evtTrigger, player, evt.triggername, evt.indexedData));
						next.set("hsskill", evt.skill);
						next.set("forceDie", true);
						next.set("ai", () => {
							return _status.event.yes;
						});
						if (typeof info.prompt2 === "function") {
							next.set("prompt2", info.prompt2(evtTrigger, player, evt.triggername, evt.indexedData));
						} else if (typeof info.prompt2 === "string") {
							next.set("prompt2", info.prompt2);
						} else if (info.prompt2 !== false) {
							if (lib.dynamicTranslate[evt.skill]) {
								next.set("prompt2", lib.dynamicTranslate[evt.skill](player, evt.skill));
							} else if (lib.translate[`${evt.skill}_info`]) {
								next.set("prompt2", lib.translate[`${evt.skill}_info`]);
							}
						}
						if (trigger.skillwarn) {
							if (next.prompt2) {
								next.set("prompt2", `<span class="thundertext">${trigger.skillwarn}。</span>${next.prompt2}`);
							} else {
								next.set("prompt2", trigger.skillwarn);
							}
						}
						result = await next.forResult();
					}
					if (result?.bool) {
						if (!get.info(trigger.skill).cost) {
							trigger.revealed = true;
						}
					} else {
						trigger.untrigger();
						trigger.cancelled = true;
					}
				},
			},
			effect: {
				charlotte: true,
				onremove: true,
				trigger: { global: ["logSkill", "useSkillAfter"] },
				intro: { content: "players" },
				forced: true,
				filter(event, player) {
					if (["global", "equip"].includes(event.type) || !player.getStorage("dckeming_effect").includes(event.player)) {
						return false;
					}
					let info = get.info(event.skill);
					if (info && info.charlotte) {
						return false;
					}
					const skill = get.sourceSkillFor(event);
					info = get.info(skill);
					const list = [skill];
					game.expandSkills(list);
					for (const i of list) {
						const info = get.info(i);
						if (!info || (!info.trigger && !info.enable) || info.silent) {
							return false;
						}
						const toArray = arr => {
							return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : !arr ? [] : [arr];
						};
						const triggers = [...toArray(info.trigger?.player), ...toArray(info.trigger?.global), ...toArray(info.enable)];
						if (triggers.some(i => ["phaseZhunbei", "phaseJieshu", "phaseUse", "chooseToUse"].some(j => i.startsWith(j)))) {
							const evtx = event.log_event || event;
							const history = _status.globalHistory[_status.globalHistory.length - 1]["everything"].slice().reverse();
							for (const evt of history) {
								if (evt.player !== event.player) {
									continue;
								}
								if (evt.name === "useCard") {
									if (evt === evtx) {
										return true;
									} else if (evt.getParent(evtx.name) === evtx) {
										return true;
									}
								}
								if (evt.name === "gain" && evt.getParent().name === "draw") {
									if (evt.getParent(evtx.name) === evtx) {
										return true;
									}
								}
								if (evt === evtx) {
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return false;
				},
				logTarget: "player",
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					const {
						targets: [target],
					} = event;
					player.unmarkAuto(event.name, target);
					if (!player.getStorage(event.name).length) {
						player.removeSkill(event.name);
					}
					const evtx = trigger.log_event || trigger;
					const cards = [];
					const skill = get.sourceSkillFor(trigger);
					const history = _status.globalHistory[_status.globalHistory.length - 1]["everything"].slice().reverse();
					for (const evt of history) {
						if (evt.player !== target) {
							continue;
						}
						if (evt.name === "useCard") {
							if (evt === evtx || (game.findSkill(evt) === skill && evt.getParent(evtx.name) === evtx)) {
								cards.push(evt.card);
							}
						}
						if (evt.name === "gain" && evt.getParent().name === "draw") {
							if (game.findSkill(evt) === skill && evt.getParent(evtx.name) === evtx) {
								cards.push(...evt.cards);
							}
						}
						if (evt === evtx) {
							break;
						}
					}
					const gain = [];
					const names = cards.map(card => get.name(card, false));
					for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(5, cards.length); i++) {
						const card = get.cardPile(card => {
							return names.includes(get.name(card)) && !gain.includes(card);
						});
						if (card) {
							gain.push(card);
						} else {
							break;
						}
					}
					if (gain.length) {
						await player.gain({ cards: gain, animate: "gain2" });
					}
				},
			},
		},
	},

						filterCard(card) {
							const player2 = get.player();

								return false;
							}
							const mod2 = game.checkMod(card, player2, "unchanged", "cardEnabled2", player2);
							if (mod2 !== "unchanged") {
								return mod2;
							}
							const mod = game.checkMod(card, player2, "unchanged", "cardRespondable", player2);
							if (mod !== "unchanged") {
								return mod;
							}
							return true;
						},
						ai(card) {
							const trigger = get.event().getTrigger();
							const player = get.player();
							const sha = trigger.card;
							if (get.effect(player, sha, trigger.player, player) < 0) {
								return 7.5 - get.value(card);

							return 0;
						},

					async target => {
						let cardsx = target.getCards("sha", { name: "sha" });
						if (cardsx.length) {
							const result = await target.modedDiscard({ cards: cardsx, discarder: player }).forResult();
							cardsx = result.cards.slice();
						} else {
							cardsx = [];
						}
						cards.push(cardsx);
					},
					() => 0
				);
				const num = cards[0].length - cards[1].length;
				if (num > 0) {
					trigger.num += num;
				}
			} else {

				await player.respond({ cards });

			const cards = get.info(event.skill).getCards(trigger, player);
			const red = cards.filter(card => get.color(card) === "red");
			const sha = cards.filter(card => get.name(card) === "sha");
			const choiceList = [`获得${get.translation(red)}中的任意张并弃置一张黑牌`, `获得${get.translation(sha)}并永久视为雷【杀】`];
			const controls = ["选项一", "选项二", "cancel2"];
			if (!red.length) {
				choiceList[0] = `<span style="text-decoration: line-through;">没有红色牌可以获得</span>`;
				controls.remove("选项一");

			if (!sha.length) {
				choiceList[1] = `<span style="text-decoration: line-through;">没有杀可以获得</span>`;
				controls.remove("选项二");
			}
			const result = await player
				.chooseControl({
					controls,
					choiceList,
					choice: (() => {
						return red.length > sha.length ? 0 : 1;
					})(),
					prompt: get.prompt2(event.skill),
				})
				.forResult();
			if (result.control !== "cancel2") {
				const index = ["选项一", "选项二"].indexOf(result.control);
				event.result = {
					bool: true,
					cost_data: index,
					cards: index === 0 ? red : sha,
				};

			const { cards, cost_data: index } = event;

	dcsbzhengong: {
		audio: 2,
		limited: true,
		skillAnimation: true,
		animationColor: "gray",

		filter(event, player) {
			return game.hasPlayer(target => target !== player);
		},
		position: "he",
		complexCard: true,
		filterCard(card, player) {
			const { cards } = ui.selected;
			if (cards.length && get.name(card) !== get.name(cards[0])) {
				return false;
			}
			return lib.filter.cardDiscardable(card, player, "dcsbzhengong");
		},
		check(card) {
			return 6 - get.value(card);
		},
		selectCard: [1, Infinity],
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			player.awakenSkill(event.name);
			const { cards } = event;
			const num = cards.length;
			const result = await player
				.chooseTarget({
					prompt: `震弓：请分配${num}点伤害给其他角色`,
					selectTarget: [num, num],
					forced: true,
					filterTarget(card, player, target) {
						return target !== player;
					},
					complexTarget: true,
					ai(target) {
						if (!_status.event.extraAIed) {
							_status.event.extraAIed = true;
							const { player, num, extraAI, check } = get.event();
							extraAI(check, player, num);
						}
						return 0;
					},
					check(target, targets) {
						let damage = get.damageEffect(target, player, player);
						if (damage <= 0) {
							return 0;
						}
						if (ui.selected.targets.includes(target)) {
							damage *= 1 - get.numOf(ui.selected.targets, target) / get.event().num;
						}
						return damage;
					},
					extraAI(check, player, num) {
						const event = get.event();
						const range = [num, num];
						const forced = event.forced;
						let ok = false;
						let iwhile = 100;
						const targets = game.filterPlayer(current => current !== player);
						let i;
						let j;
						let targets2;
						let effect;
						while (iwhile--) {
							if (ui.selected.targets.length >= range[0]) {
								ok = true;
							}
							targets2 = targets.slice(0);
							let ix = 0;
							CacheContext.setCacheContext(new CacheContext({ lib, game, get }));
							CacheContext.setInCacheEnvironment(true);
							let checkix = check(targets[0], targets2);
							for (i = 1; i < targets.length; i++) {
								const checkixtmp = check(targets[i], targets2);
								if (checkixtmp > checkix) {
									ix = i;
									checkix = checkixtmp;
								}
							}
							if (check(targets[ix]) <= 0) {
								if (!forced || ok) {
									CacheContext.setInCacheEnvironment(false);
									CacheContext.removeCacheContext();
									return;
								}
							}
							CacheContext.setInCacheEnvironment(false);
							CacheContext.removeCacheContext();
							targets[ix].classList.add("selected");
							ui.selected.targets.push(targets[ix]);
							game.check();
							if (ui.selected.targets.length >= range[0]) {
								ok = true;
							}
							if (ui.selected.targets.length >= range[1]) {
								return;
							}
						}
					},
					num,
				})
				.set("promptbar", "none")
				.set("custom", {
					add: {},
					replace: {
						target(target, e) {
							const event = get.event();
							if (!event.isMine() || !event.filterTarget(void 0, event.player, target)) {
								return;
							}
							if (!target.classList.contains("selectable")) {
								return;
							}
							if (ui.selected.targets.length >= event.selectTarget[1]) {
								return;
							}
							target.unprompt();
							target.classList.add("selected");
							ui.selected.targets.push(target);
							const count = get.numOf(ui.selected.targets, target);
							target.prompt(`伤害×${count}`);
							game.check();
						},
					},
				})
				.forResult();
			const { targets } = result;
			if (targets?.length) {
				const list = targets.slice();
				targets.unique();
				player.line(targets);
				await game.doAsyncInOrder(targets, async target => {
					target
						.when({
							player: "damageEnd",
							global: ["phaseBeforeStart", "phaseAfter"],
						})
						.filter(evt => {
							if (evt.name === "phase") {
								return true;
							}
							return evt.getParent() === event || evt.getTrigger().getParent() === event;
						})
						.then(async (event, trigger, player) => {
							if (trigger.name === "phase") {
								return;
							}
							player.addTempSkill("fengyin");
						});
					return target.damage({ num: get.numOf(list, target) });
				});
			}
		},
		ai: {
			order: 8,
			result: {
				player(player, target) {
					if (game.hasPlayer(target => target !== player && get.damageEffect(target, player, player) > 0)) {
						return 1;
					}
				},
			},
		},
	},

	//刘璿
	mogui: {
		audio: 2,
		trigger: { player: ["phaseJudgeBegin", "phaseDrawBegin", "phaseDiscardBegin"] },
		filter(event, player) {
			if (player !== _status.currentPhase) {
				return false;
			}
			const storage = player.getStorage("mogui");
			if (event.name === "phaseJudge") {
				return !storage.includes("phaseJudge");
			}
			if (event.name === "phaseDraw") {
				return !storage.includes("phaseDraw");
			}
			if (event.name === "phaseDiscard") {
				return !storage.includes("phaseDiscard") && player.hasCards("he");
			}
			return false;
		},
		async cost(event, trigger, player) {
			const storage = player.getStorage(event.skill);
			if (trigger.name === "phaseJudge" && !storage.includes(trigger.name)) {
				event.result = await player
					.chooseTarget(get.prompt(event.skill), "令一名角色回复1点体力并弃置判定区所有牌")
					.set("ai", target => {
						const player = get.player();
						const att = get.attitude(player, target);
						if (!player.awakenedSkills.includes("zunjian")) {
							return att;
						}
						const effectOk = get.recoverEffect(target, player, player) > 0;
						const hasBadCards = target.hasCards("j", card => {
							const vcard = {
								name: card.viewAs || card.name,
								cards: [card],
							};
							return get.effect(target, vcard, target, target) < -1;
						});
						return att * (effectOk + hasBadCards);
					})
					.forResult();
			} else if (trigger.name === "phaseDraw" && !storage.includes(trigger.name)) {
				event.result = await player
					.chooseTarget(get.prompt(event.skill), "令一名角色摸牌阶段摸牌数和使用【杀】的次数上限+1")
					.set("ai", target => {
						const player = get.player();
						return get.attitude(player, target);
					})
					.forResult();
			} else if (trigger.name === "phaseDiscard" && !storage.includes(trigger.name)) {
				event.result = await player
					.chooseCardTarget({
						prompt: get.prompt(event.skill),
						prompt2: "弃置至多五张牌，令一名角色手牌上限+1并摸等量张牌",
						filterCard: lib.filter.cardDiscardable,
						selectCard: [1, 5],
						allowChooseAll: true,
						filterTarget: true,
						position: "he",
						ai1(card) {
							return 7 - get.value(card);
						},
						ai2(target) {
							const player = get.player();
							return get.attitude(player, target);
						},
					})
					.forResult();
			}
		},
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const {
				targets: [target],
				cards,
			} = event;
			player.markAuto(event.name, [trigger.name]);
			if (trigger.name === "phaseJudge") {
				await target.recover();
				const cards = target.getCards("j");
				if (cards.length > 0) {
					await target.discard(cards, target);
				}
			} else if (trigger.name === "phaseDraw") {
				target.addMark(`${event.name}_effect`, 1, false);
				target.addSkill(`${event.name}_effect`);
			} else if (trigger.name === "phaseDiscard") {
				await player.discard(cards);
				target.addMark(`${event.name}_hand`, 1, false);
				target.addSkill(`${event.name}_hand`);
				await target.draw(cards.length);
			}
		},
		onremove: true,
		intro: { content: `已移除选项：$` },
		subSkill: {
			effect: {
				charlotte: true,
				onremove: true,
				intro: { content: "摸牌阶段摸牌数和使用【杀】的次数上限+#" },
				trigger: { player: "phaseDrawBegin2" },
				forced: true,
				popup: false,
				filter(event, player) {
					return !event.numFixed;

	zunjian: {

				.set("ai", () => {

	rencheng: {
		audio: 2,
		enable: "phaseUse",
		usable: 1,
		manualConfirm: true,
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const bool = player.storage[event.name];
			const num = bool ? 3 : 2;
			await player.draw(num);
			if (!game.hasPlayer(current => current !== player) || !player.hasCards("he")) {
				return;
			}
			const result = await player
				.chooseCardTarget({
					prompt: `仁诚：你可交给一名其他角色至多${get.cnNumber(num)}张牌`,
					position: "he",
					selectCard: [1, num],
					filterTarget: lib.filter.notMe,
					ai1(card) {
						return 7 - get.value(card);
					},
					ai2(target) {
						const player = get.player();
						let att = get.attitude(player, target);
						if (target.hasSkillTag("nogain")) {
							att /= 10;
						}
						return att;
					},
				})
				.forResult();
			if (result?.bool && result.cards?.length && result.targets?.length) {
				const {
					targets: [target],
					cards,
				} = result;
				player.line(target);
				await player.give(cards, target);
				if (!bool) {
					return;
				}
				if (cards.some(card => get.type(card) === "basic")) {
					target.addSkill(`${event.name}_effect`);
				}
				if (cards.some(card => get.type2(card) === "trick") && game.hasPlayer(current => current.hasDiscardableCards(player, "hej"))) {
					const result = await player
						.chooseTarget({
							prompt: "仁诚：你可以选择一名角色，然后弃置其区域内的一张牌",
							filterTarget(card, player, target) {
								return target.hasDiscardableCards(player, "hej");
							},
							ai(target) {
								const player = get.player();
								return get.effect(target, { name: "guohe_copy" }, player, player);
							},
						})
						.forResult();
					if (result?.targets?.length) {
						const [target] = result.targets;
						player.line(target);
						await player.discardPlayerCard(target, "hej", true);
					}
				}
				if (cards.some(card => get.type(card) === "equip")) {
					await player.recover();
					await target.recover();
				}
			}
		},
		ai: {
			order: 7,
			result: { player: 1 },
		},
		subSkill: {
			rewrite: {},
			effect: {
				charlotte: true,
				mark: true,
				intro: { content: "下个出牌阶段使用牌无距离限制" },
				trigger: { player: "phaseUseBegin" },
				forced: true,
				popup: false,
				firstDo: true,
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					player.removeSkill(event.name);
					player.addTempSkill("rencheng_nodistance", "phaseUseAfter");
				},
			},
			nodistance: {
				charlotte: true,
				mark: true,
				intro: { content: "本阶段使用牌无距离限制" },
				mod: {
					targetInRange(card, player, target) {
						return true;
					},
				},
			},
		},
	},
	//张裕
	dcxiangchen: {
		audio: 2,
		init(player, skill) {
			if (!_status.characterlist) {
				game.initCharacterList();
			}
		},
		keepSkill: true,
		enable: "phaseUse",
		usable: 1,
		filterTarget: true,
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			const {
				targets: [target],
			} = event;
			player.setStorage(event.name, target);
			player.markSkillCharacter(event.name, target, "相谶", "上次〖相谶〗的目标");
			if ((player.additionalSkills[event.name] || []).length >= 3) {
				await player.draw({ nodelay: true });
				return;
			}
			const groupx = target.group;
			const hps = [get.character(target.name).hp, get.character(target.name2).hp];
			const skillsx = player.getSkills(null, false, false).filter(skill => !get.info(skill).charlotte);
			/** @type { [skill: string, owner: string][] } */
			const skills = [];
			for (const name of _status.characterlist) {
				const { group, hp, skills: curSkills } = get.character(name);
				if (groupx !== group || !hps.includes(hp)) {
					continue;
				}
				skills.unshift(
					...curSkills
						.filter(skill => {
							const info = get.info(skill);
							if (!info || info.charlotte || info.juexingji || info.hiddenSkill || info.zhuSkill || info.limited) {
								return false;
							}
							if (typeof info.groupSkill === "string" && info.groupSkill !== player.group) {
								return false;
							}
							if (info.ai && (info.ai.combo || info.ai.notemp || info.ai.neg)) {
								return false;
							}
							return !skillsx.includes(skill);
						})
						.map(/** @returns { [skill: string, owner: string] } */ skill => [skill, name])
				);
			}
			if (skills.length) {
				const result = await player
					.chooseButton({
						createDialog: [`相谶：请选择一个技能获得`, [skills.randomGets(3), "skill"]],
						forced: true,
						ai(button) {
							return get.skillRank(button.link, "inout");
						},
					})
					.forResult();
				if (result.links?.length) {
					await player.addAdditionalSkills(event.name, result.links, true);
				}
			} else {
				player.chat("天有不测风云啊");
			}
		},
		ai: {
			order: 8,
			result: {
				target(player, target) {
					if (target === player) {
						return Math.random() - 0.5;
					}
					const sgn = get.sgnAttitude(player, target);
					const name = target.name;
					const hp = get.character(name).hp;
					if (hp >= 3 && hp <= 5) {
						return sgn * (Math.random() + 1);
					}
					return sgn * Math.random();
				},
			},
		},
		group: ["dcxiangchen_changeHp", "dcxiangchen_clear"],
		subSkill: {
			changeHp: {
				audio: "dcxiangchen",
				trigger: { global: "changeHpAfter" },
				filter(event, player) {
					if (event.changedHp === 0 || !event.player.isIn()) {
						return false;
					}
					return event.player === player || player.getStorage("dcxiangchen", null) === event.player;
				},
				direct: true,
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					const skill = "dcxiangchen";
					const next = player.chooseToUse({
						prompt: get.translation(skill),
						prompt2: get.skillInfoTranslation(skill, player),
					});
					next.set("norestore", true);
					next.set("_backupevent", skill);
					next.set("custom", {
						add: {},
						replace: { window() {} },
					});
					next.backup(skill);
					next.set("ai1", () => 1);
					next.set("ai2", target => {
						const eff = get.effect(target, "dcxiangchen", get.player(), get.player());
						return eff;
					});
					next.set("addSkillCount", false);
					await next;
				},
			},
			clear: {
				audio: "dcxiangchen",
				forced: true,
				locked: false,
				trigger: { player: "phaseEnd" },
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					await player.removeAdditionalSkills("dcxiangchen");
					//await player.recover();
				},
			},
		},
	},
	dcmingding: {
		audio: 2,
		limited: true,
		skillAnimation: true,
		animationColor: "orange",
		trigger: { player: "dying" },
		check(event, player) {
			if (
				player.countCards("h", card => {
					const mod2 = game.checkMod(card, player, "unchanged", "cardEnabled2", player);
					if (mod2 !== "unchanged") {
						return mod2;
					}
					const mod = game.checkMod(card, player, event.player, "unchanged", "cardSavable", player);
					if (mod !== "unchanged") {
						return mod;
					}
					let savable = get.info(card).savable;
					if (typeof savable === "function") {
						savable = savable(card, player, event.player);
					}
					return savable;
				}) >=
				1 - event.player.hp
			) {
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		},
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			player.awakenSkill(event.name);
			const toRemove = player.getSkills(null, false, false).filter(skill => skill !== event.name && !get.info(skill).charlotte);
			if (toRemove.length) {
				await player.removeSkills(toRemove);
			}
			await player.recoverTo(1);
			player.addTempSkill(`${event.name}_effect`, { player: "dieAfter" });
			player
				.when({ player: "phaseAfter" })
				.filter(evt => evt !== trigger.getParent("phase", true))
				.then(async (event, trigger, player) => {
					player.removeSkill("dcmingding_effect");
				});
			const toAdd = [];
			game.checkAllGlobalHistory("everything", evt => {
				if (evt.name !== "changeSkills" || evt.player !== player || evt.getParent()?.name !== "dcxiangchen") {
					return false;
				}
				toAdd.addArray(evt.addSkill);
				return true;
			});
			await player.draw({ num: Math.min(5, toAdd.length) });
			await player.addSkills(toAdd.randomGets(3));
			player.addTempSkill(`${event.name}_die`, { player: "dieAfter" });
			player.setStorage(`${event.name}_die`, trigger.getParent("phase", true));
		},
		subSkill: {
			effect: {
				audio: "dcmingding",
				charlotte: true,
				forced: true,
				intro: {
					content: "防止你受到的伤害",
				},
				mark: true,
				trigger: {
					player: "damageBegin4",
				},
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					trigger.cancel();
				},
				ai: {
					nodamage: true,
					effect: {
						target(card, player, target, current) {
							if (get.tag(card, "damage")) {
								return "zeroplayertarget";
							}
						},
					},
				},
			},
			die: {
				audio: "dcmingding",
				charlotte: true,
				onremove: true,
				forced: true,
				intro: {
					content: "回合结束时失去所有体力",
				},
				mark: true,
				marktext: "💀",
				trigger: {
					player: "phaseEnd",
				},
				filter(event, player) {
					return event !== player.storage.dcmingding_die;
				},
				async content(event, trigger, player) {
					player.removeSkill(event.name);
					await player.loseHp(player.getHp());
				},
			},
		},
	},
	//神姜维
	jiufa: {
		getList(player, event, mark = true) {
			const list = [];
			const history = game.getAllGlobalHistory("everything", evt => ["jiufa", "useCard", "respond"].includes(evt.name) && evt.player === player, event);
			for (let i = history.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
				const evt = history[i];
				if (evt.name === "jiufa") {
					if (evt.jiufa_mark) {
						break;
					}
				}
				if (["useCard", "respond"].includes(evt.name)) {
					list.add(evt.card.name);
				}
			}
			if (list.length && mark) {
				player.markAuto("jiufa", list);
			}
			return list;
		},
		init(player, skill) {
			const list = get.info("jiufa").getList(player, null, false);
			if (list.length) {
				player.markAuto("jiufa", list);
			}
		},
		onremove: true,
		audio: 2,
		trigger: { player: ["useCard", "respond"] },
		frequent: true,
		filter(event, player) {
			return get.info("jiufa").getList(player, event).length >= 9;
		},
		async content(event, trigger, player) {
			player.setStorage("jiufa", [], true);
			event.set("jiufa_mark", true);
			const cards = get.cards(9);
			event.cards = cards;
			event.cards.sort((a, b) => get.number(b) - get.number(a));
			await game.cardsGotoOrdering(event.cards);
			event.videoId = lib.status.videoId++;
			game.broadcastAll(
				(player, id, cards) => {
					let str;
					if (player === game.me && !_status.auto) {
						str = "九伐：选择点数满足条件的牌各一张";
					} else {
						str = "九伐";
					}
					const dialog = ui.create.dialog(str, cards);
					dialog.videoId = id;
				},
				player,
				event.videoId,
				event.cards
			);
			event.time = get.utc();
			game.addVideo("showCards", player, ["九伐", get.cardsInfo(event.cards)]);
			game.addVideo("delay", null, 2);
			const num = [...cards.map(card => get.number(card)).reduce((map, number) => map.set(number, (map.get(number) || 0) + 1), new Map())].filter(([number, count]) => count > 1).length;
			const next = player.chooseButton(num, true);
			next.set("dialog", event.videoId);
			next.set("filterButton", button => {
				const num = get.number(button.link);
				const cards = _status.event.getParent().cards;
				for (const buttonx of ui.selected.buttons) {
					if (get.number(buttonx.link) === num) {
						return false;
					}
				}
				for (const card of cards) {
					if (card !== button.link && get.number(card) === num) {
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			});
			next.set("ai", button => get.value(button.link, get.player()));
			const result = await next.forResult();
			const time = 1000 - (get.utc() - event.time);
			if (time > 0) {
				await game.delay(0, time);
			}
			game.broadcastAll("closeDialog", event.videoId);
			if (result?.links?.length) {
				await player.gain(result.links, "log", "gain2");
			}
		},
		marktext: "⑨",
		intro: {
			content: "已记录牌名：$",
			onunmark: true,
		},
	},
	tianren: {
